assets.name: Bách
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for Soul of Meal: ONE character animation atlas, transparent RGBA background. Reference image 1 is the identity source (the corresponding person among five labelled columns); preserve their face, age, hair, clothing cues. Reference image 2 is only layout and cel-shaded chibi game-rendering style, do not copy the lion. Character: mature Vietnamese man, swept brown hair with grey streak at temples, warm dark eyes, neat moustache and short goatee. Ivory rolled-sleeve chef shirt, burgundy apron with restrained warm gold Vietnamese rice-pattern border, brown boots. A closed brown recipe notebook at belt, bronze round tray shield and wooden-handled ladle. Stocky dependable build. Distinct actions: weighty shield-leading walk, ladle chop, shield plant and book-command gesture; ultimate plant shield and raise recipe book, then command forward, then recover. Victory warmly raise ladle and salute.
Create exactly 32 isolated full-body poses in a mathematically regular 4-column by 8-row grid on a 1024x2048 portrait canvas. Each cell exactly256x256, generous transparent gap between neighboring actors. All actors face three-quarter RIGHT, body proportions 3 heads tall; clear fine cel shading, readable clothing, polished original anime RPG art. Uniform scale and feet near bottom of each cell; all hands, tools, ribbons inside cell, no clipping. Rows top to bottom:1 idle breathing (4 subtly varied poses);2 walking (4 clear alternating leg steps);3 basic attack (ready, windup, contact, recovery);4 casting (prepare, gather, release, recover);5 ultimate (preparation, cast, decisive impact, recovery);6 taking hit (recoil through recovery);7 death (stagger, kneel, collapse, lying safely on ground);8 victory (4 joyful character-specific poses). Keep facial identity, tools, and outfit identical in all32. VFX only tiny controlled cues; no huge aura, no background, no floor, no grid lines, no letters or labels. Separate whole figures with visible transparent gutters. Death row still stays entirely in its own cell.
